extension.description: Organize local Codex tasks in a sortable, nestable project tree with groups, recent activity, pinned state, archive, and search.
view.name: Projects and Tasks
command.openTaskNative: Codex Navigator: Continue in Native UI
command.deleteTask: Codex Navigator: Permanently Delete Archived Task
command.removeInvalidLocalTask: Codex Navigator: Remove Invalid Local Task Record
command.createTask: Codex Navigator: Create Task in Official Codex…
command.addTaskFolder: Codex Navigator: Add from Local Task Folder…
command.addTaskById: Codex Navigator: Add Task by ID…
command.promoteProject: Codex Navigator: Promote to Top-Level Project

config.viewMode.compatible: Compatible hierarchy mode: show the official Codex view and hierarchy tree together.
config.viewMode.exclusive: Exclusive hierarchy mode: hide the official Codex task list and continue tasks in the native Codex conversation editor.
config.viewMode.description: Choose whether the official Codex view remains visible beside the hierarchical navigator.
config.codexCommand.description: Codex executable name or absolute path. The extension can fall back to the executable bundled with openai.chatgpt.
config.recentLimit.description: Maximum tasks shown under Recent. The list follows task activity automatically.
config.maxTasks.description: Maximum active or archived tasks loaded from Codex.
config.autoRefreshSeconds.description: Optional polling fallback in seconds. Task activity events update the tree immediately; 0 disables polling.
config.sourceKinds.description: Codex task sources included in the navigator.
config.defaultOpenMode.native: Continue in the official native Codex conversation editor with model selection, approval controls, and touch input.
config.defaultOpenMode.terminal: Run codex resume in the VS Code terminal.
config.defaultOpenMode.menu: Show the open-mode menu whenever a task is clicked.
config.defaultOpenMode.description: Action used when a task is clicked. Native UI is recommended for mouse and touch use.
